Italian-American kitchen · wood-fired oven

Our menu

Wood-fired pizza, pasta, chicken parm, Italian subs, salads, wings, desserts, and beer, wine and cocktails. Dough and sauce made from scratch: our East Hartford commissary kitchen supplies the Connecticut Pegs, and Delray Beach makes its own in-house.

Live menu & prices for your PegCatering menu

Italian classics

Pasta
